data.disagreement_analysis: The first model returned 'inconclusive' because it encountered an HTTP 400 BadRequestError when attempting to audit the .SRCINFO file. The second model successfully audited the .SRCINFO file and all other files, returning 'safe'. The disagreement is an artifact of a tool failure, not a difference in security analysis.
learnings: Transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) during the audit of generated metadata files like .SRCINFO should not force an overall 'inconclusive' package verdict. The tool should implement retries or gracefully ignore .SRCINFO failures if the primary PKGBUILD is successfully audited and deemed safe, as .SRCINFO is just a static reflection of the PKGBUILD.
